$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFAY (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Amiens - Glisy

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous TKOF and LDG on unpaved RWY and paved RWY prohibited.
Any TKOF and/or LDG on the paved RWY must be stopped if a glider lies on the half of the grass RWY adjoining the paved RWY.
Possible IFR operations (GNSS).
AD prohibited for ACFT > 5.7 t.
Turbulence and downwash in final RWY 12 by South/South-West wind due to hangars and woods.
Wavy RWY profile: bad visibility from holding point THR 30 and vice versa, due to wavy RWY longitudinal profile.
Group of trees R 120/1.23 NM LFAY ARP.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Acces to paved RWY via paved TWY A: width 10 m.
A by-pass TWY on the paved TWY A allows two ACFT with a maximum wingspan of 12,25 m to pass one another when taxiing to the parking.
Follow published circuits whenever possible.
Platform sensitive to noise.
Aerobatics NR 6070: see AIP ENR 5.5
Gliders activity Activities known and announced on A/A and LILLE INFO.
PCL: 3 clicks: turns on lighting; 5 clicks: turns on lighting + flashing lights; 7 clicks: switches off.
Automatically switches off after 15 minutes.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
TKOF et LDG simultanés sur piste non revêtue et piste revêtue interdits.
Tout TKOF et/ou LDG sur la piste revêtue doit être suspendu si un planeur est immobilisé sur la demilargeur contigüe de la RWY en herbe.
Activité IFR possible (GNSS).
AD interdit aux aéronefs > 5.7 t.
Turbulences et rabattants en finale RWY 12 lors de vent du Sud/Sud-Ouest dûs aux hangars et bois.
Profil de la piste ondulé : mauvaise visibilité du point d'attente du seuil 30 et inversement, en raison du profil longitudinal de la piste bombée.
Groupe d'arbres R 120/1.23 NM LFAY ARP.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Accès piste revêtue par le TWY revêtu A : largeur 10 m.
Bretelle sur TWY revêtu A utilisable par les ACFT au roulage vers le parking et permettant le croisement de 2 ACFT d'envergure maximale 12,25 m.
Respecter les circuits publiés dans la mesure du possible.
Plateforme sensible au bruit.
Voltige N°6070 : voir AIP ENR 5.5
Activité planeurs Les activités sont connues et annoncées sur A/A et LILLE INFO.
PCL : 3 coups d'alternat : allumage du balisage ; 5 coups d'alternat : allumage balisage + feux à éclats ; 7 coups d'alternat : extinction.
Extinction automatique après 15 minutes.
